_about: Public-domain John Nelson (1707-1774), the Birstall stonemason who became one of Wesley's first lay preachers, for the Word Hoard: his Extract from the Journal, written by himself (London, 1795; Baltimore, 1810; New York, 1833, with an account of his death), from Internet Archive scans. Not the other John Nelsons on the shelves. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jnelson-journal-1795: An Extract from the Journal of Mr. John Nelson, Preacher of the Gospel, written by himself (London: G. Paramore; sold by G. Whitfield, 1795)
jnelson-journal-1810: An Extract from the Journal of Mr. John Nelson, written by himself (Baltimore: J. Kingston, 1810)
jnelson-journal-1833: Extract from the Journal of John Nelson, written by himself, to which is added an account of his death (New York: B. Waugh and T. Mason, 1833)

_alternates.jnelson-copies: London 1798 (year OCR'd '179%'); a second Baltimore 1810 copy; New York 1854; the undated Wesleyan-Methodist Book-Room Extract (its catalogued 1767 is impossible)
